data.desc: Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: PPIH) is a global leader in engineered piping and corrosion protection solutions. The Company provides pre-insulated piping systems, leak detection systems, anti-corrosion coatings and related engineered products and services to customers across the energy, district energy, infrastructure, industrial, Oil & Gas, water transmission, and other critical infrastructure markets. Perma-Pipe operates manufacturing and service facilities across North America , Middle East , North Africa , India and other strategic markets, enabling the Company to serve customers globally while providing local manufacturing and engineering capabilities.
